Step 1's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0419-20260902/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json, result.summary) reached a reasoned NO-CHANGE verdict: the CI cache is NOT being defeated, evidenced by 3 real cache-hit CI runs (ids 33634490464, 33635645070, 33622754837) showing mix deps.get completing in ~1s and zero Cargo/rustc compile output in the subsequent backend-gate step, consistent with Rustler.Compiler.compile_crate/3's structural no-op path on a cache hit. The ~12 min runtime is dominated by the ExUnit suite itself (~694s of ~720s total in the cited run), not by wasmex rebuilding. CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0 is genuinely absent from ci.yml's literal text but genuinely active on the live job (injected by dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable into $GITHUB_ENV) -- both premises reconciled as true, and it is structurally irrelevant on a cache-hit run since Cargo is never invoked. No fix was made and none is needed.

Add the no_defect-specific keys: verdict_in_run: WF03-ISS0419-20260902, verdict_at: <real UTC timestamp from the clock, not copied from this handoff>. Do NOT use resolved_in_run:/resolved_at: -- those assert a resolution that did not happen. In the yaml, cite: the diagnosis handoff path (handoffs/WF03-ISS0419-20260902/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json), the first-hand measurement (3 real CI run ids and what was found in each), the specific mechanisms tested (mix deps.get runtime, Cargo-compile-output absence, compile_crate/3's structural no-op logic, CARGO_INCREMENTAL:0's live-env-vs-source-text reconciliation), and the stated method limitation (local repro blocked by a Rust toolchain pin mismatch on this host, 1.93.1 installed vs wasmex's Cargo.lock requiring 1.94.0+, so CI-log evidence was used instead of a local mtime-based repro).
2. github_issue: 817 is set and gh is reachable (confirmed: gh auth status shows logged in as tvolodi). Close it: `gh issue close 817 --comment "..."` using EXACTLY the no_defect comment template from WF-03 Step 5 / ISSUE_QUEUE.md: "Investigated and measured in WF03-ISS0419-20260902; no defect found and nothing was changed. No fix was made and there is no regression test. See docs/issues/ISS-0419.yaml and the diagnosis handoff at handoffs/WF03-ISS0419-20260902/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json." Never claim a fix or cite a regression test -- there is neither.
3. Commit docs/issues/ISS-0419.yaml (and this handoff) to git on the current branch feature/WF03-ISS0419-20260902, and push.
4. Complete this handoff: result.status PASS, next_action "Route to Step Final (git merge) -- ORCH performs the merge itself since ELIXIR-DEV already ran Step 00 on this same branch and there is no further code change to make."
